info.title: DHCP_Relay_V6_Mcast_Server
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

ipv6_multicast_address.description:
Reference Resource: [DHCP_Relay_V6_Mcast_Server](#/DHCP_Relay_V6_Mcast_Server)
Packets received through these ports are duplicated and forwarded. This entry holds a reference to the egress ports for each IPv6 mcast address. A maximum of 8 IPv6 servers are allowed. This count includes IPv6 unicast servers from "ipv6_ucast_server".

ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
List of egress Ports, Packet forwarding takes place through these Ports.

parameters.name: DHCP_Relay.vrf
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [DHCP_Relay](#/DHCP_Relay)
VRF through which DHCP server is reachable.

parameters.name: DHCP_Relay.port
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [DHCP_Relay](#/DHCP_Relay)
Layer 3 Port on which the configuration is made.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
